goal: Refine the Kokoro Link presentation to one second with the title above the centered source and effect recipient below.
acceptance_criteria: Each activation presents only the selected reserve monster large in the center for one 1000ms sequence.
The Kokoro Link title is above the monster and the named effect recipient is centered below it.
The monster holds through the middle of the sequence, flashes strongly from 700ms to 850ms, and exits by 1000ms.
Battle busy state is not changed and the linked aura remains after the sequence.
Reduced-motion users keep a calm one-second centered presentation.
Save data, IDs, effect values, target binding, and activation rules remain unchanged.
